summary: Align PHP and MySQL session timezone with System → General for Activity History / audit timestamps; keep grievance effective_at and date_recorded as naive business datetimes with no conversion; label header clock as Local.

notes: SET time_zone offset on PDO connect

backup_restore: Timezone keys live in app_settings (included in backup dump). No schema migration. Restore does not rewrite grievance effective_at / date_recorded. Re-save System → General after restore if org timezone should differ from DEFAULT UTC.
api_postman: GET /api/history items[].created_at in org TZ; response may include timezone; regenerate Postman notes via generate-collection.cjs
grievance_effectivity_guard: No bulk update or timezone conversion on effective_at or date_recorded; SET time_zone is session-only.
